events.title: Fields of Fun in Every Region
events.description: A weekend of occasions, each one worthy of your best hat. Race day at Beaudesert. An exclusive eight-course showcase at Blume. Estate wines overlooking Lake Wyaralong. Then Sunday begins before dawn, floating above ancient peaks in a hot air balloon as the Scenic Rim reveals itself below. Dress for it.

events.title: Harvesting & Family Fun
events.description: Hand the kids the shovel, the show bag, and the beekeeping suit and watch what happens. Three days of sixth-generation farmland, Queensland's largest carrot farm, Kalbar Show fireworks, edible flower picking, and golden honey straight from the hive. Every meal tastes better when you helped grow it.

events.title: A Weekend for the Senses
events.description: This weekend asks you to get involved. Churn butter on a sixth-generation farm, harvest mystery garden ingredients before cooking them into something extraordinary, feast fireside high above the valley, then close Sunday with working beehives and a native rainforest orchard walk as the sun sets over Main Range.
